# Financial Model Comparison (auto-generated by tools/compare_models.py)

All figures from each model's Python mirror (identical to the XLSX formulas; see verify_fin_model.py). Operating profit is EBITDA-basis before owner compensation. Peak funding = maximum cumulative cash deficit after owner draw (the capital actually at risk). 'Deployable' = cumulative surplus after reinvestment and reserves (10-yr). These are model outputs from evidenced-but-unvalidated drivers — not forecasts.
